lines.en: I tap on Nodoka's name in my phone and wait for her to answer.
: What? Why? What if I wasn't calling to invite you over?
: Then you wouldn't be calling at all.
: Shall I bring a whip? Or will just my body suffice?
: Just your body is fine. I'll see you soon, Nodoka.
: So...will you be taking me here? Or would you rather we do it on your daughter's bed?
How should I spend my time with Nodoka?
